notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Scaretiller, targeting a basic land you control.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Vesuva from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Gods' Eye.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability from step 1, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai
